feature_construction.label: 特征构造
feature_construction.scope: Construct input features solely from supplied training interactions, such as frequency or recency indicators. No external metadata, independent scorer or score fusion. Keep learned embedding design, SASRec topology, readout, loss and optimizer fixed.

embedding_representation.label: 嵌入表征
embedding_representation.scope: Item embedding dimensions, parameterization, tying and embedding normalization. Keep feature definitions, interaction/scoring mechanism, SASRec topology, history policy, loss and optimizer fixed.

interaction_mechanism.label: 交互机制
interaction_mechanism.scope: Jointly trained user-interest/item interaction or scoring mechanisms, such as gated or bilinear compatibility. Preserve the causal Transformer backbone topology, input features, history readout, loss and optimizer. No independently trained score fusion.

network_architecture.label: 网络架构
network_architecture.scope: SASRec attention block depth, attention heads, feed-forward layers, residual paths and internal network topology. Retain the SASRec causal Transformer backbone. Preserve input features, embedding design, scoring mechanism, history selection/readout, loss and optimizer.

sequence_modeling.label: 序列建模
sequence_modeling.scope: Causal input context length, truncation and ordering/position representation. Preserve input feature definitions, embedding design, SASRec topology, interest readout, loss and optimizer. Never introduce future interactions or change supplied splits.

interest_aggregation.label: 兴趣聚合
interest_aggregation.scope: Readout of existing causal encoder states, such as last-state, mean, recency-weighted or attention pooling, inside one jointly trained model. Preserve input history selection, embedding construction, backbone topology, scoring mechanism, loss and optimizer.

learning_objective.label: 学习目标
learning_objective.scope: Ranking/prediction loss, loss weighting and jointly trained auxiliary objectives. Preserve feature definitions, embeddings, SASRec topology, scoring/readout, optimizer, sampling, scheduler and batch/epoch settings.

training_strategy.label: 训练策略
training_strategy.scope: Optimizer, learning rate, batch size, scheduler, dropout and weight decay. Preserve model structure, features, scoring/readout and loss definition. Keep seed 42, epoch cap 200, data splits, evaluation and GPU/CPU allocation fixed.

regular_routing: one TS draw for each of eight directions; select the top four without replacement for four GPUs
gpu_budget_allocation: selection frequency allocates slots over rounds; equal per-candidate caps within a group; charge actual worker duration
regular_reward: Bernoulli success iff valid host validation strictly exceeds the group-start local incumbent
jump_routing: budget-safe gate; draw from the eight direction posteriors; combine highest draw with highest cross-parent compatible draw; G=1
jump_credit: one delayed combination_jump outcome counter; no unidentifiable component-direction credit and no separate prior for each pair
edit_contract: exact selected direction set, per-direction nontrivial AST edits, logged rationale; semantic scope prompt-enforced
